exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: Stand with feet together, jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead, return to start.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower hips back and down, keep chest up, return to standing.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Plank position, lower chest to floor, push back up.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.description: Forearm plank, keep body straight and hold.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: Step forward, lower hips until both knees are bent at 90°, return to start, alternate legs.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: Plank position, alternate bringing knees toward chest quickly.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: Squat, kick feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump forward, jump up.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on back, knees bent, feet on floor, lift hips up, squeeze glutes.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Sit on chair, hands on edge, slide forward, lower body by bending elbows, push up.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: Lie on back, legs raised, alternate bringing elbow to opposite knee.

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell or weight at chest, squat as normal.

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
exercises.description: Hands on elevated surface, perform push-up at an angle.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift
exercises.description: Balance on one leg, hinge forward at hips, reach for floor, return.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Lie on side, support body on forearm, keep straight, hold.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.description: Step backward, lower into lunge, return to standing, alternate.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Run in place, bringing knees up to waist height.

exercises.name: Push-ups (wide)
exercises.description: Push-up with hands wider than shoulders.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.description: Lie face down, extend arms and legs, lift them off floor, hold.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.description: Step onto a bench or chair, alternate leading leg.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Taps
exercises.description: Plank position, alternate tapping opposite shoulder with hand.

exercises.name: Squat Jumps
exercises.description: Perform squat, jump up explosively, land softly.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.description: Push-ups with hands forming a diamond under chest.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.description: Lie on back, legs straight, kick up and down alternately.

exercises.name: Cossack Squats
exercises.description: Wide stance, squat to one side while other leg stays straight, alternate.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: Lie on back, arms up, legs bent 90°, alternate extending opposite arm and leg.

exercises.name: Bear Crawls
exercises.description: On hands and feet, move forward and backward, keep back flat.

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.description: Downward dog position, lower head toward floor, push up.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raises
exercises.description: Lie on back, legs straight, raise them to 90°, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Skater Jumps
exercises.description: Jump laterally from one leg to the other, swinging arms.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank with Hip Dips
exercises.description: Forearm plank, rotate hips side to side, touching floor.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunges
exercises.description: Lunge, jump to switch legs in air, land in lunge.

exercises.name: Decline Push-ups
exercises.description: Feet elevated on bench, perform push-up.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Glute bridge with one foot elevated, alternate.

exercises.name: Side Lunges
exercises.description: Step out to side, squat over that leg, return, alternate.

exercises.name: V-Ups
exercises.description: Lie back, arms overhead, simultaneously lift legs and torso, touch toes.

exercises.name: Barbell Squats
exercises.description: Barbell on back, squat down, return to standing.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie on bench, lower barbell to chest, press up.

exercises.name: Bent Over Rows
exercises.description: Bend over, pull barbell toward lower chest.

exercises.name: Deadlifts
exercises.description: Lift barbell from floor to hip height.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: Hang from bar, pull chin over bar.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: On parallel bars, lower body until elbows 90°, push up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Seated leg press machine, push weight away.

exercises.name: Cable Crossovers
exercises.description: Stand between cables, pull handles together in front.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: Sit with weight, twist torso side to side.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
exercises.description: Seated, pull cable handle to torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells to sides until shoulder height.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts
exercises.description: Barbell deadlift with stiff legs, hinge at hips.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.description: Hang from bar, raise legs to parallel.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: Bend over, row dumbbell with one arm.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Rotate dumbbells from front to overhead while pressing.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrusts
exercises.description: Sit on floor, barbell over hips, thrust up.

exercises.name: Cable Crunches
exercises.description: Kneel, pull cable down toward knees.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press with hands close together (triceps focus).

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.description: Seated, pull bar down to chest.

exercises.name: Leg Curls
exercises.description: Lying leg curl machine, curl weight.

exercises.name: Plank with Arm Reach
exercises.description: Plank, reach one arm forward, hold, alternate.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunges
exercises.description: Barbell on back, perform walking lunges.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Cable face pulls, pull toward face.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollouts
exercises.description: Kneel, roll ab wheel forward and back.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
exercises.description: Seated, pull cable handle to torso.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Seated leg press machine, push weight away.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.description: Hang from bar, raise legs to parallel.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Run in place with high knees.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: Bodyweight squats, partial range if needed.
